title: Three Rotated Anisotropic Ellipses (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_anisotropic` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Three equal-mass 2D Gaussians stretched along horizontal, vertical, and diagonal axes. Tests full 2x2 covariance fidelity so that matching a wide principal axis cannot hide collapse along the narrow axis.
failure_mode: Scalar-trace isotropic covariance trackers or misallocated prototype mass distort ellipse eccentricity and violate component_covariance_error or mass_tv.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_anisotropic`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
